title: Printer on the third floor jams
body: Use tray 2 for A4 paper and keep tray 1 for envelopes. If it still jams, call facilities on extension 2210.

title: Guest Wi-Fi
body: The guest network is CYB-Guest. Its password rotates every Monday and is posted at reception.

title: Resetting an admin's two-factor
body: Another instance admin can turn off two-factor for an admin in the instance settings. A single admin who lost the device needs the recovery codes.

title: Invoice INV-2041 dispute
body: Customer Nordlys ApS disputed INV-2041 because the delivery was late. Credit note CN-118 was issued for 10 percent.

title: Postgres connection limits
body: max_connections is 200 on the primary. Each service connects through pgbouncer with a pool size of 20.

title: Budget approvals
body: Budgets above 50,000 EUR need CFO approval; above 500,000 EUR the board decides.

title: Company bike scheme
body: Employees can lease a bike through salary sacrifice with an allowance of 30 euros a month.

title: Nordlys ApS main contact
body: The main contact at Nordlys ApS is Mette Holm in procurement. She prefers email over phone calls.

title: Coffee machine descaling
body: The canteen coffee machine is descaled every second Friday by the cleaning team.

title: Staging database refresh
body: Staging is refreshed from an anonymised production snapshot every Sunday night at 02:00.
